THE HEART OF ROTIWALA

Har Roti Mein Ghar Ka Ehsaas.

The comfort of home, one roti at a time.

RotiWala brings that feeling to the centre of its brand, with premium fulka roti, convenient ordering enquiries and a signature packaging identity designed to feel as inviting as the food itself.

HELPFUL ANSWERS

Your Roti Delivery Questions, Answered.

Useful answers about roti-only orders, service areas, free delivery, pricing and WhatsApp enquiries.

01Where can I order fresh roti online in Ahmedabad?+

You can order roti online in Ahmedabad by contacting Roti Wala on WhatsApp. We serve Juhapura and Sarkhej in Ahmedabad, and also deliver to Gandhinagar. Ask for the current quantity and price before confirming your order.

02Does Roti Wala deliver chapatis in Juhapura?+

Yes. Roti Wala offers free chapati and roti home delivery in Juhapura, Ahmedabad. Tell us your area and quantity on WhatsApp so we can discuss your order.

03Is roti home delivery available in Sarkhej?+

Yes. Fresh chapati home delivery and roti-only enquiries are available in Sarkhej with free home delivery. You can order rotis without purchasing a complete meal.

04Does Roti Wala provide roti delivery in Gandhinagar?+

Yes. We provide free roti and chapati home delivery in Gandhinagar. Our only confirmed physical location is at Ujala Circle in Ahmedabad; Gandhinagar is a delivery area.

05Can I order only rotis without sabzi or a full meal?+

Yes. If you are looking for roti-only delivery near you, ask for our fresh fulka roti, rotli or wheat chapati options. You do not need to order sabzi or an entire meal.

06How much does one roti cost in Ahmedabad?+

Prices may vary by quantity and order requirements. For the current roti price per piece in Ahmedabad, WhatsApp Roti Wala with your required quantity to receive accurate pricing.

07Does Roti Wala offer free home delivery?+

Yes. Roti Wala offers free home delivery in Juhapura and Sarkhej, Ahmedabad, and Gandhinagar. Please share your exact area when enquiring so we can confirm the order details.

08Can I place a bulk order for chapatis?+

Yes. For a bulk roti order in Ahmedabad or a bulk chapati supplier enquiry for restaurants, caterers, offices or events, message the team with your required quantity, date and location.

09Can I enquire about daily or monthly roti delivery?+

Yes. If you need daily roti delivery in Ahmedabad or a monthly chapati delivery service, ask us about a recurring arrangement. Availability, quantity, pricing and schedule must be confirmed before ordering.

10How do I order chapatis through WhatsApp?+

Tap an Order on WhatsApp button, or fill out the enquiry form with your name, mobile number, quantity and delivery area. WhatsApp will open with a prefilled message; your order is not confirmed until Roti Wala agrees to the details.

Still have a question? Ask Roti Wala on WhatsApp.
